photos.title: The Palms Resort from above
photos.what: The Palms Resort from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): two white oceanfront towers with a pool beside the southern one stand on the beach side of North Ocean Boulevard, two parking lots lie across the road, and the beach and the Atlantic Ocean run along the right. Labels placed from coordinates (labels.json).
photos.caption: The Palms Resort from above, with the beach and the ocean to the east.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of the two Palms Resort towers on the oceanfront in Myrtle Beach, labelled, with the beach and the Atlantic Ocean to the east
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-17; the exact request is in source_request.
photos.license_note: Same source and terms as the batch 2026-11-e NAIP record (data/2026-11-e/bay-view-resort/photos.json).
photos.credit: Photo: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP, public domain, via The National Map (USGS). Labels by Chapter3 Realty.
photos.changes: Chapter3 Realty cut this view from the NAIP service and added labels placed from map data
